category_edits.rationale: Normalize nonpadding item vectors to unit RMS and apply one jointly learned positive global scale initialized to the initial embedding RMS. The shared lookup applies this representation to histories, training targets, and prediction candidates across all four datasets. The generated predictor imports SASRec from train.py and loads its state dictionary, including the new scale parameter.
